summary_1line: Sages led by Chyavana arrive at Rama’s court seeking an audience, and Rama respectfully welcomes them and offers help.

image_candidates.scene_text: Over a hundred radiant sages led by Chyavana enter Rama’s golden audience hall carrying fruits, roots, and water from sacred places.
Rama stands with joined palms before the seated sages on golden seats, respectfully asking how he may serve them.
